CORS_FORBIDDEN.title: Untrusted Domain
CORS_FORBIDDEN.detail: We blocked this request because it came from an unrecognized or untrusted domain.

FORBIDDEN.title: Permission Denied
FORBIDDEN.detail: You are not permitted to perform this action. Your account doesn't have the necessary access rights.

ACCESS_DENIED.title: Access Blocked
ACCESS_DENIED.detail: You don't have permission to view or modify this specific information.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: Authentication Required
UNAUTHORIZED.detail: Your session has expired or you aren't signed in. Please log in to continue.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not Found
NOT_FOUND.detail: We couldn't find what you were looking for. The item might have been deleted or the link is incorrect.

CONFLICT.title: Data Conflict
CONFLICT.detail: This information already exists in our system, or someone else modified it while you were working.

BAD_REQUEST.title: Invalid Request
BAD_REQUEST.detail: There was a problem with the information you submitted. Please check your details and try again.

VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Validation Failed
VALIDATION_ERROR.detail: Some of the details you entered are invalid. Please review your inputs and correct any errors.

TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.title: Too Many Requests
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.detail: You are doing that too fast. Please wait a moment before trying again.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: File Too Large
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.detail: The file or data you are trying to upload exceeds our maximum size limit. Please try a smaller file.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: System Error
INTERNAL_ERROR.detail: Something went wrong on our end. Our team is looking into it.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service Unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Our service is temporarily down for maintenance or experiencing high traffic. Please try again later.
